title: Resource reminder …
excerpt: A series of 51 twenty-minute podcasts are available here on the site – an overview of the Bible. They’re really inexpensive and a lot of people have told me they’re the most helpful resource I’ve ever made available. Also – you can download some music I’ve written here.
body:
